events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar coffee-truck pop-up debuting the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte before The Nitro Bar's planned NYC opening.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised each day, with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins candy; the first 100 guests each day are also advertised to receive a limited-edition Reese's × The Nitro Bar koozie, all while supplies last.
events.caveats: The Hershey Company confirms the NYC pop-up dates as September 14–15. Current local listings and Patch agree that public service begins at 11 AM at Astor Place Plaza and continues while supplies last. Secondary listings disagree on a fixed end time, so no unsupported closing time is claimed here.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation at Astor Place Plaza in front of Chase Bank. Arrive early if the latte or first-100 koozie is the priority because inventory is explicitly limited.

events.address: The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A one-night NYFW beauty pop-up bringing together the public, Sephora Squad members, beauty editors and influencers for personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is advertised via RSVP, with personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments included in the event experience.
events.caveats: The direct RSVP page is live and the event is described as open to the public with RSVP. No organizer-approval requirement or paid ticket price was established in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 5–8 PM at The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery. Use the direct RSVP page before traveling.

events.event_name: FDLA × United Palace: The Life of Giannina Azar
events.brand: Fashion Designers of Latin America × United Palace
events.address: United Palace, 4140 Broadway, New York, NY 10033
events.what_it_is: An immersive runway showcase by designer Giannina Azar with live performance by Maria Del Sol, presented by Fashion Designers of Latin America and United Palace.
events.what_is_free: General admission was complimentary with RSVP.
events.caveats: The official United Palace ticket page currently shows both $0 general-admission sections as sold out. Do not describe this as an available free RSVP even though admission was complimentary.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14. Official ticketing lists doors at 6 PM and the show at 7 PM at United Palace. Advance general admission is currently sold out.
